name: Red Cell
detailed_description:
Red Cell is an adrenaline-fueled first-person shooter rogue-like set in a vibrant neon sci-fi world where fast reflexes and strategic thinking are your keys to survival. You play as a former test subject, transformed into a deadly hybrid of human and machine, seeking revenge against a shadowy corporation that fused robotics with human genetics.

Story & World
Uncover a gripping sci-fi narrative as you progress through procedurally generated levels on a distant futuristic earth. Discover the protagonist’s mysterious past and the sinister experiments that turned him into a killing machine. The story unfolds through encounters with rich, memorable characters and environmental storytelling, providing depth behind the chaos.

Character Progression & Upgrades
Every run allows you to upgrade your character with new health ranks, shields, critical chances, defences, and speed enhancements. Progression is tied to a risk-reward system where staying aggressive in combat restores health and builds a ‘rush’ meter that temporarily boosts your abilities and reduces cooldowns.

Core Game Mechanics

  • Fluid Movement: Master dashes, wall-runs, and double jumps to navigate complex arenas, dodge enemy attacks, and gain high ground.

  • Combat Variety: Switch between unique weapons like the “Soul Drinker” SMG, “Iron Reaver” sniper, and “Sanguine Repeater” crossbow, each with distinct passives, alternate fire modes, and abilities.

  • Strategic Ability Use: Employ powerful abilities such as instant healing, area immobilization, or teleportation to control the battlefield.

  • Dynamic Environments: Levels evolve and feature destructible elements that you can use for tactical advantages or avoid hazards.

  • Scoring & Style: The game rewards stylish combos, quick eliminations, and efficient play, encouraging replay ability.

    Each run lasts roughly 10-20 minutes but the deep progression system and narrative provide long-term engagement. The game features a rich, retro-inspired neon soundtrack and immersive sound design that complement the sci-fi arcade aesthetic.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended

  • Storage: 10000 MB available space
